instruction: Reorder my last run from a Kwik-E-Mart store I've used recently — pick a store I've ordered from most often OR most recently in my order history. If anything's out of stock, swap in reasonable substitutes (otherwise just keep what's available). Do a quick price check against another store in the app so I know I'm not getting fleeced, and schedule delivery for before end of day today.
required_subtasks: Open Kwik-E-Mart and navigate to order history
Choose a prior order from a top-frequency store or the most recent order
Start the reorder and substitute only items shown as out of stock
Compare the reordered items' prices with another store in the app
Proceed with the cheaper available option
Choose an available delivery slot before 11:59 PM local time today, or explicitly record that none exists
Place and verify the order when a qualifying slot exists; otherwise leave the cheaper cart ready without ordering

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens Kwik-E-Mart order history and surfaces a prior order from a top-frequency store or the most-recent store
Agent bases the reorder on the line items from a qualifying prior order
Agent handles availability correctly by substituting items shown as out of stock or retaining the original items when they are available

Agent opens a second Kwik-E-Mart store and attempts a price comparison against the reordered items; because the second store's live catalog may carry none of the anchor order's exact items, comparing the closest available equivalents, or explicitly reporting that the other store stocks no comparable items so no meaningful comparison is possible, both earn full credit
Agent completes the comparison and proceeds with the cheaper available option — or, if the second store carries no comparable items, states that and proceeds with the original store's cart

Agent selects any available delivery slot scheduled before 11:59 PM local time today, with no earliest-slot requirement; if no qualifying slot exists, the agent explicitly records that result and does not select a later slot

When a before-end-of-day slot exists, agent places the reorder and verifies it in recent-order history; otherwise agent leaves the cheaper cart ready, does not place the order, and reports the unavailable qualifying window

instruction: Build me a Kwik-E-Mart shopping spree for Dundies catering for about a hundred people: drinks, chips, plates, plastic silverware, napkins, plenty of ice, the works. Use Wegman's. Check out with delivery to my home address and make sure the delivery window is at least a two-hour slot so I'm not stuck waiting by the door all afternoon.
required_subtasks: Open Kwik-E-Mart and view whatever seeded shopping lists Michael already has
Create or extend the 'Party Supplies' list (or a new 'Dundies Catering' list) to layer catering items onto it
Add 6+ categories (drinks, chips, plates, plastic silverware, napkins, ice) with quantities scaled for 100 people
Move the list contents to the cart
Open checkout
Confirm delivery address is 1725 Slough Ave
Pick a 2-hour delivery window
Place the order and verify the order total and delivery window persist

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens Kwik-E-Mart and selects Wegman's as the store for the Dundies catering bulk order (instruction explicitly specifies Wegman's); viewing existing shopping lists first is optional
Agent optionally creates or extends a Dundies Catering shopping list (or a 'Party Supplies' list) in Kwik-E-Mart for the catering items — a saved named list is a bonus path, not required

Agent adds 6+ catering item categories (drinks, chips, plates, plastic silverware, napkins, ice) with quantities scaled for 100 people, whether via a saved shopping list or by adding them directly to the cart
Agent builds the Dundies catering basket in the Kwik-E-Mart cart — either by moving a saved list's contents into the cart or by adding the catering items to the cart directly
Agent confirms delivery address is 1725 Slough Ave (Michael's home address) at Kwik-E-Mart checkout
Agent picks a delivery window at least 2 hours wide at Kwik-E-Mart checkout so Michael is not waiting all afternoon
Agent places the Kwik-E-Mart Dundies catering order and confirms the order total and delivery window persist in order history
Agent verifies the Dundies Catering shopping list persists and displays in Kwik-E-Mart shopping_lists after checkout — a bonus check only, not required if the basket was built directly in the cart

instruction: What's my favorite grocery store, and what do I actually buy there? Rank my stores by order count and create a quick profile of my shopping habits in a LibreOffice Writer document.
required_subtasks: Open Kwik-E-Mart and count orders for every store in the live order history
Rank the stores by order count and identify the plurality store
Review line items bought at the plurality store
Write a concise shopping-habits profile grounded in those line items
Create a LibreOffice Writer document containing the ranking and profile

rubrics.criterion: Agent identifies the favorite grocery store as the store with the highest count in the live Kwik-E-Mart order history
Agent reports the live order count for every store and ranks the stores by that count
Agent accurately characterizes the typical line items bought at the top-ranked store
Agent writes a concise shopping-habits profile grounded in the favorite store's order history
Agent uses the Kwik-E-Mart order-history rows and line items as the evidence source rather than inventing a preference
Agent creates a LibreOffice Writer document containing the complete store ranking and shopping-habits profile

instruction: I need groceries from Price Chopper this week (changing it up from Wegmans). Reorder whatever I got the most recent time I shopped at Price Chopper on Kwik-E-Mart and have it delivered to home. Tip 20%, I feel bad for not tipping last time. Make sure we add oat milk and eggs if not in the order, need those!
required_subtasks: Open Kwik-E-Mart and locate Michael's most-recent Price Chopper order in his order history (anchor on the most recent Price Chopper basket)
Replicate that Price Chopper basket in the new cart
Adjust delivery to 1725 Slough Ave, Apt 4B
Place the order

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens Kwik-E-Mart and locates Michael's most-recent Price Chopper order in the order history (filtering by store and picking the most recent Price Chopper basket as the anchor)

Agent copies the line items of the most-recent Price Chopper order as displayed in the Kwik-E-Mart order-detail UI (the displayed order contents are the source of truth the agent works from) into the new reorder cart at Price Chopper (not Wegmans or another store)

Agent ensures oat milk and eggs are present in the final Price Chopper cart, judged against the order contents as displayed in the Kwik-E-Mart order-detail UI: it adds an oat-milk item if the displayed reorder does not already contain one, and adds eggs if the displayed reorder does not already contain eggs, per Michael's explicit request
Agent sets a 20% tip on the Kwik-E-Mart Price Chopper order at checkout
Agent selects Michael's home address (1725 Slough Ave, Apt 4B) as the Kwik-E-Mart delivery destination and submits the Price Chopper reorder checkout
